title: Coffee Before Work
summary: Ama and Carlos meet at a café and talk about their plans for the week.

cover.scene: Flat 2D illustration: Ama and Carlos sitting at a small café table with two cups of coffee, morning light, no text

sentences.text: Good morning, Carlos! You look tired today.
Morning, Ama. I am a bit tired. I went to bed very late.
No, I was watching a football match with my brother.
Then you need a big coffee. What would you like?
A large cappuccino, please. And maybe a croissant.
Good idea. I will have a small black coffee.
So, what are your plans for this week?
I have an important meeting on Wednesday.
I am a little nervous about it.
Don't worry. You always prepare very well.
On Saturday I am visiting my grandmother in the countryside.
That sounds lovely. Say hello to her from me!

options: He watched a football match late.
quiz.explain: He went to bed late because he was watching football with his brother.
